nodes.description: Payable fallback function that reads calldata and executes an inline assembly CALL proxy.
Low-level CALL using user-controlled gas, destination address, and value forwarded from calldata.
Assembly local _dst, the destination address loaded from calldataload(0).
Assembly local _gas, the gas amount loaded from calldataload(32).
Assembly local _value, the value loaded from calldataload(64).
Assembly local _len, the calldata length after the first 96 bytes.
Assembly local ret, the success flag returned by the low-level call.
Assembly local result_len, the returndatasize after the call.
Unchecked assembly subtraction sub(calldatasize, 96) that can underflow when calldata is shorter than 96 bytes.

edges.reason: Fallback executes inline assembly low-level CALL without restricting caller or destination, allowing arbitrary value transfer.
The low-level CALL can transfer control to an arbitrary callee that may re-enter the fallback.
_dst is assigned from calldataload(0) inside the fallback assembly.
_gas is assigned from calldataload(32) inside the fallback assembly.
_value is assigned from calldataload(64) inside the fallback assembly.
_len is assigned from sub(calldatasize, 96) inside the fallback assembly.
ret is assigned from the low-level call result.
Fallback executes unchecked assembly subtraction for calldata length, underflowing when calldatasize is less than 96.
The underflowing subtraction result is stored in _len.
_dst is used as the target address argument of the call.
_gas is used as the gas argument of the call.
_value is used as the value argument of the call.
_len is used as the call data length argument of the call.
The call returns its success flag into ret.
returndatasize() after the call is stored in result_len.

normalization_plan.reason: _dst is an assembly local used as the call destination, so it normalizes into the unsafe CALL operation.
_gas is an assembly local used as the call gas, so it normalizes into the unsafe CALL operation.
_value is an assembly local used as the call value, so it normalizes into the unsafe CALL operation.
_len is directly produced by the unchecked sub operation, so it normalizes into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
ret is the result of the CALL, so it normalizes into the unsafe CALL operation.
result_len is derived from the CALL, so it normalizes into the unsafe CALL operation.
